parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The name of the database account associated with the instance.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. This token is generated by the client and must be unique for each request. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the source instance.

parameters.name: Extensions
parameters.description: The extensions to create. Separate multiple extensions with a comma (,).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: SourceDBName
parameters.description: The name of the source database.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the endpoint is located.
